bundle.shortDescription: Local-first lifetime license vault with keep-alive reminders
bundle.longDescription: Perpetua is a local-first desktop vault for lifetime software licenses. Track renewals and inactivity windows, get keep-alive reminders, export/backup your vault, and unlock Pro via Polar or offline keys. Built with Tauri 2 + SvelteKit + Rust/Axum + SQLite.
